answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in inlet and thread lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ocean graph. Verification costs 7 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 857 account sybil into a 16 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
